hero.title: Forty-two hours
hero.lede: A hand-wound three-hand watch, wound each morning at the crown. It is keeping your local time right now. Scroll to open it up.
hero.firstText: 38 mm steel case, 11 mm thick, three hands and nothing else.

stages.title: Meridian 38, assembled
stages.text: 38 mm steel case, 11 mm thick, three hands and nothing else.

stages.title: Sapphire crystal
stages.text: Domed sapphire with anti-reflective coating inside, sealed to 100 m.

stages.title: Dial and hands
stages.text: A grained dial with lumed hands, set on two dial feet.

stages.title: The going train
stages.text: Five wheels carry the mainspring energy to the escapement.

stages.title: The escapement
stages.text: 28,800 beats an hour, regulated in five positions.

stages.title: Back together
stages.text: Closed up, regulated, and keeping your time.

configure.title: Build yours.
configure.accent: The watch above changes with it.
configure.body: Choose a case, a dial and a strap. Each Meridian 38 is assembled and regulated to order.

wind.title: Thirty turns of the crown.
wind.body: The MW-42 is wound by hand. Drag the crown clockwise; each turn adds 1.4 hours, and the reserve runs down in real time.

dual.title: Your time on the hands.
dual.accent: One more on the red arrow.
dual.body: The Field GMT adds a 24-hour hand for a second time zone, read against the outer ring. Pick a city to set it.

specs.title: Measured in millimetres,
specs.body: Watchmakers measure movements in lignes, about 2.26 mm each. Switch units to see the Meridian the way the bench does.

footer.fine: Meridian is a concept brand for a demo site made with SiteRemade.

_decisions: Set the winding demo to the 42 hours in the brief, from 30 crown turns (1.4 hours a turn)
Switched off the dual-time section and its nav link: the brief describes a three-hand watch with no second time zone
Redrew the straps as black rubber, navy canvas, olive nylon and sand leather, and the cases as black DLC and bronze, in the brief's colours
